items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy used to come up to the club and sit in and make these screaming sounds and they'd chase him out.

ctx.x: They thought it, you know, here it is.
When I was working with Skeets Talbot from club at the Black Cat, Dizzy used to come up to the club and sit
in and make these screaming sounds and they'd chase him out.

items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I know that from Dizzy because Dizzy worked with him in the Frank Fairfax band

ctx.x: Yeah, I know that from Dizzy because Dizzy worked with him in the Frank Fairfax band
and he said he called him "Joe Trumpet" and he still calls him "Joe Trumpet."
